title: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Ltd - 543978 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

summary.headline: Ratnaveer guides FY27 top line of ~1,350-1,500 crore and FY28 consolidated 2,500 crore incl. 750 crore from new CCL plant; FY26 standalone OCF negative ~48 crore.
summary.overview: Management reiterated a growth plan built around a new copper-clad laminate (CCL) plant in Gujarat, with first line targeted for November 2026 production and five lines over about two years. FY26 top line was 1,078 crore against a 1,350 crore target for the current year, with stainless/fastener business guided at about 25% CAGR. Cash flow questions drew a contested answer: an analyst cited FY26 standalone operating cash flow of about negative 48 crore, while management attributed the low cash generation to capex advances, depreciation and QIP funds held as FDs. Receivables rose sharply (analyst cited about 65 crore to 175 crore), which management attributed to new product launches and longer credit to new customers.

segments.name: Stainless steel fasteners and washers (existing business)
segments.commentary: Management guided 25% CAGR, with 1,350 crore target for the current year and about 1,800 crore in three years. Company claims largest SKU count for stainless washers in India and serves 31 countries.

segments.name: Copper-clad laminate (CCL, new)
segments.commentary: Five-line plant with 338 crore ECMS approval; first line targeted November 2026. Individual CCL business guided at about 20% EBITDA and 13% PAT, with 750 crore revenue at 69% utilisation targeted for FY28.

guidance_outlook: FY27 top line: management said 1,350-1,400 crore is the base case, and that it remains on track for about 1,500 crore after an analyst flagged a downgrade from earlier 1,500 crore guidance.
FY28 consolidated target of about 2,500 crore revenue, 13-13.5% EBITDA and about 10.5% PAT, including 750 crore from CCL.
CCL first line production targeted November 2026; machine dispatch from China around July 2026; installation August-October 2026.
Remaining four CCL lines to be installed over the next two years depending on first-line performance; utilisation of 80-85% targeted by 2028, with 69% assumed conservatively.
Expected PLI and state incentives (about 50% of capex from central and state schemes, power cost exemption, interest subsidy) cited, with disbursement in about 4-5 months after project completion.
Planned 330 crore fundraise (QIP or equivalent) targeted for completion by September 2026; remaining warrant balance to be converted by about September 2027.
Proposed acquisition of a European precision components company: management said due diligence will take about 10-12 more months.
capex_capacity: CCL plant: 5 lines in total under ECMS (338 crore approval); project cost about 351 crore plus about 46 crore solar; split about 70% plant and machinery (turnkey), 80% building, and 12% miscellaneous (as stated).
Machinery ordered from a Chinese technology partner; advance paid January 2026 and second tranche paid; second-round inspection completed; civil and PV work in progress.
Technology agreement signed December 2025; partner to supply machinery, install, train staff and provide 1.5-2 years of quality support. Management said no royalty is payable.
Plant is in Gujarat; land already owned by the company.
Capex 1, Capex 2 and Capex 2A referenced as ongoing for the existing business.
demand_pricing: Management claims no anti-dumping duty currently on CCL imports and states 10-13% price competitiveness versus imports; Indian PCB makers receive 2% cash subsidy for buying indigenous material (as stated).
Management says the five lines would be about 2% of Indian CCL demand, which it says is growing 30-35% (or 35-40% CAGR per another comment).
Soft confirmations received from PCB companies; no firm pre-orders yet. Management said one or two customers may be ready to buy the first line.
Management said the Iran war (about 45-60 days) has not affected demand; oil and gas and consumable costs rising, and management said these can be passed on to customers.
Customer concentration: top 5 washer customers about 2-5% of sales; top finishing-line customers about 10-12%.

qa_highlights.question: Are the warrants at 159 due for conversion and will they be forfeited?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 25% was already paid, the balance can be converted, and the 18-month window runs to about September 2027.

qa_highlights.question: Rationale for CCL, technical tie-up terms and competition from China and Korea?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the partner is paid through machinery purchase, with no royalty; the plant is fully automated and it claims 10-13% price advantage versus imports.

qa_highlights.question: Consolidated FY28 2,500 crore plan and FY26 revenue base?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 1,078 crore in FY26 and 1,350 crore target this year, with the existing business growing 25% CAGR to 1,800 crore and CCL adding 750 crore in two years.

qa_highlights.question: Negative operating cash flow and capex funding?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO Ajay Panchal said net cash flow of 203 crore was inflated by QIP funds held as FDs, and that advances to capex suppliers and depreciation drove the weak FY26 operating cash flow; the analyst's 48 crore figure was not directly rebutted.

qa_highlights.question: Receivables rising from 65 crore to about 175 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said receivables rose on new products, new customers and launch credit, and expects normalisation as the business matures; no quantified timeline was given.

qa_highlights.question: PLI incentive quantum and timing on 70 crore capex?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about 50% of eligible capex (25% central plus 25% state) would be reimbursed, received within about 3-6 months of completion, and power, logistics and interest subsidies also apply.

risks_watch: CCL execution: Chinese machinery arrival around July 2026, monsoon impact on civil works, and first production target November 2026.
Funding gap: 330 crore raise targeted by September 2026 to fund CCL project and working capital; execution risk on fundraise timing.
Cash flow and receivables: negative operating cash flow reported by analyst for FY26, and receivables growth well above revenue growth.
Warrant conversion and dilution: promoter stake may fall from about 47-48% to 42-43% after QIP and warrants.
Management statements on CCL demand (soft confirmations only, no firm orders) and the European acquisition (10-12 months to close) are unverified.
Some management answers were unclear or inconsistent (e.g., CCL CAGR quoted as both 30-35% and 35-40%; guidance changed between 1,350 and 1,500 crore for FY27).
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on the CCL opportunity and growth targets, but evasive on cash flow and receivables, and inconsistent on several figures and guidance numbers.
